title: SoLonely x sadeyes: Take My Scars
description: A cinematic visualizer for SoLonely and sadeyes, created for Take My Scars.
overview: Take My Scars turns the song's emotional tension into a restrained visual world built around motion, light and repetition.
Dark frames, isolated color and a slowly evolving visual language keep the focus on the track while giving the lyric video a distinct atmosphere.
